resources.string: Enter the full server address. It must start with http:// or https://.
The server does not answer. Check the address and the network connection.
This address is not a Koillection login. Check the path in the URL: a missing or extra subpath is the usual cause.

The server failed to make a login token (HTTP 500). Usually its JWT keys do not match JWT_PASSPHRASE, for example after a container restart made a new passphrase. The website can still work in this state. Check JWT_PASSPHRASE and the JWT keys on the server.
The server answered with an error (HTTP %1$d).
The login failed with an unexpected error.
